annotations.title: Find other choices for a trip item

description: Lists the other choices for one priced line of a planned trip's option (a stay, a flight, a transfer or an activity), numbered, each with its price and what it does to the whole trip's Safe Trip Total and budget. Use it when the traveller wants a different hotel, flight, transfer or activity. The trip id, option id and line id come from plan_trip or get_trip. Read only: the trip is not changed. It searches the travel providers again, so choices and prices can differ from one call to the next; the numbers can be used with swap_trip_item for 30 minutes.

lineId.description: The line id from plan_trip or get_trip, e.g. 'N-STAY-1'.

optionId.description: The option id from plan_trip or get_trip.

tripId.description: The trip id that plan_trip returned.
